title: Fresh Animations for HEOV
description: Makes Fresh Animations compatible with HEOV!
body:
Makes the villagers and zombies from HEOV compatible with Fresh Animations

**This is a modification of the Human Era resource pack that I made for a specific server with friends**. The original work is from [BishopMCNuggets](https://modrinth.com/user/BishopMCNuggets), you can check the original resoruce pack [clicking here](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/human-era-villagers-illagers) which is compatible with a large number of mods, please make sure to check it out!

Make sure to apply this resource pack on top of the original HEOV pack
